verdict.rationale: Some plugin management works outside the UI. There is a CLI command (`codex plugin marketplace add`), config.toml editing, file-based `plugin.json` manifests, and `$skill-installer` for skills. However, plugin browsing and installation go through an interactive `/plugins` browser or the Plugins tab, and submission and publication tracking are portal-only. No OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), so nothing shows a documented API matching UI capabilities. Missing for 10: a documented programmatic API for installing and managing plugins, an API for submission and publication, an OpenAPI or reference spec, and any explicit statement or corroboration of UI/API parity.
